decisions.reason: As a close-to-core line that still had its own page two years after launch, it appears to have cleared the first market test and is inexpensive for the firm to keep while continuing to earn from it.

The serum remains on the website after two years, so the option still looks viable, but its lighter website presence suggests somewhat weaker revealed performance and therefore a higher chance of later pruning than A.

Because this close-to-core product was launched only in 2024, uncertainty about its full value is still resolving and a small integrated producer would usually keep such a low-cost option open for another year unless results turn clearly poor.
